name: lpp-domoved
description: Domoved: pre-purchase check of an apartment or a house in Russia. Accepts ЦИАН, Домклик, Авито, Яндекс/2ГИС/Google Maps links or an address. Scores noise, the building, legal risks, transport, ecology, greenery, schools, amenities, safety, price and liquidity, growth potential. Produces a total score, a recommendation and an HTML report in Russian.
